verses.original: כַּשֶּׁ֤לֶג׀ בַּקַּ֗יִץ וְכַמָּטָ֥ר בַּקָּצִ֑יר כֵּ֤ן כָּבֽוֹד׃ לֹא־ נָאוֶ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל
verses.transliteration: kaš·še·leḡ baq·qa·yiṣ wə·ḵam·mā·ṭār baq·qā·ṣîr kên kā·ḇō·wḏ lō- nā·weh liḵ·sîl
verses.literal: Like snow in summer and rain at harvest . . . honor does not befit a fool

verses.original: לָ֭נוּד כַּצִּפּ֣וֹר לָע֑וּף כֵּ֥ן כַּדְּר֣וֹר חִ֝נָּ֗ם קִֽלְלַ֥ת לֹא תָבֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: lā·nūḏ kaṣ·ṣip·pō·wr lā·‘ūp̄ kên kad·də·rō·wr ḥin·nām qil·laṯ lō ṯā·ḇō
verses.literal: Like a fluttering sparrow or darting . . . swallow an undeserved curse does not come to rest

verses.original: שׁ֣וֹט לַ֭סּוּס מֶ֣תֶג לַחֲמ֑וֹר וְ֝שֵׁ֗בֶט לְגֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šō·wṭ las·sūs me·ṯeḡ la·ḥă·mō·wr wə·šê·ḇeṭ lə·ḡêw kə·sî·lîm
verses.literal: A whip for the horse a bridle for the donkey and a rod for the backs of fools

verses.original: אַל־ תַּ֣עַן כְּ֭סִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּ֑וֹ פֶּֽן־ אָֽתָּה׃ תִּשְׁוֶה־ לּ֥וֹ גַם־
verses.transliteration: ’al- ta·‘an kə·sîl kə·’iw·wal·tōw pen- ’āt·tāh tiš·weh- lōw ḡam-
verses.literal: Do not answer a fool according to his folly or you yourself will be like him . . . . . .

verses.original: עֲנֵ֣ה כְ֭סִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּ֑וֹ פֶּן־ יִהְיֶ֖ה חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·nêh ḵə·sîl kə·’iw·wal·tōw pen- yih·yeh ḥā·ḵām bə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: Answer a fool according to his folly lest he become wise in his own eyes

verses.original: מְקַצֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַיִם שֹׁתֶ֑ה חָמָ֣ס שֹׁלֵ֖חַ דְּבָרִ֣ים בְּיַד־ כְּסִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: mə·qaṣ·ṣeh raḡ·la·yim šō·ṯeh ḥā·mās šō·lê·aḥ də·ḇā·rîm bə·yaḏ- kə·sîl
verses.literal: Like cutting off one’s own feet or drinking violence is the sending of a message by the hand of a fool

verses.original: מִפִּסֵּ֑חַ שֹׁ֭קַיִם דַּלְי֣וּ וּ֝מָשָׁ֗ל בְּפִ֣י כְסִילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mip·pis·sê·aḥ šō·qa·yim dal·yū ū·mā·šāl bə·p̄î ḵə·sî·lîm
verses.literal: Like lame legs hanging limp is a proverb in the mouth of a fool

verses.original: כִּצְר֣וֹר אֶ֭בֶן בְּמַרְגֵּמָ֑ה כֵּן־ נוֹתֵ֖ן כָּבֽוֹד׃ לִכְסִ֣יל
verses.transliteration: kiṣ·rō·wr ’e·ḇen bə·mar·gê·māh kên- nō·w·ṯên kā·ḇō·wḏ liḵ·sîl
verses.literal: Like binding a stone into a sling is the giving of honor to a fool

verses.original: ח֭וֹחַ עָלָ֣ה בְיַד־ שִׁכּ֑וֹר וּ֝מָשָׁ֗ל בְּפִ֣י כְסִילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·w·aḥ ‘ā·lāh ḇə·yaḏ- šik·kō·wr ū·mā·šāl bə·p̄î ḵə·sî·lîm
verses.literal: [Like] a thorn [that] goes into the hand of a drunkard is a proverb in the mouth of a fool

verses.original: רַ֥ב מְחֽוֹלֵֽל־ כֹּ֑ל וְשֹׂכֵ֥ר כְּ֝סִ֗יל וְשֹׂכֵ֥ר עֹבְרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: raḇ mə·ḥō·w·lêl- kōl wə·śō·ḵêr kə·sîl wə·śō·ḵêr ‘ō·ḇə·rîm
verses.literal: Like an archer who wounds at random is he who hires a fool or passerby

verses.original: כְּ֭כֶלֶב שָׁ֣ב עַל־ קֵא֑וֹ כְּ֝סִ֗יל שׁוֹנֶ֥ה בְאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḵe·leḇ šāḇ ‘al- qê·’ōw kə·sîl šō·w·neh ḇə·’iw·wal·tōw
verses.literal: As a dog returns to its vomit so a fool repeats his folly

verses.original: רָאִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯā ’îš ḥā·ḵām bə·‘ê·nāw tiq·wāh liḵ·sîl mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Do you see a man who is wise in his own eyes There is more hope for a fool than for him

verses.original: עָ֭צֵל אָמַ֣ר שַׁ֣חַל בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ אֲ֝רִ֗י בֵּ֣ין הָרְחֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ṣêl ’ā·mar ša·ḥal bad·dā·reḵ ’ă·rî bên hā·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: The slacker says A lion [is] in the road A fierce lion [roams] the public square

verses.original: הַ֭דֶּלֶת תִּסּ֣וֹב עַל־ צִירָ֑הּ וְ֝עָצֵ֗ל עַל־ מִטָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: had·de·leṯ tis·sō·wḇ ‘al- ṣî·rāh wə·‘ā·ṣêl ‘al- miṭ·ṭā·ṯōw
verses.literal: [As] a door turns on its hinges so the slacker [turns] on his bed

verses.original: עָצֵ֣ל טָ֘מַ֤ן יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת נִ֝לְאָ֗ה לַֽהֲשִׁיבָ֥הּ אֶל־ פִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ṣêl ṭā·man yā·ḏōw baṣ·ṣal·lā·ḥaṯ nil·’āh la·hă·šî·ḇāh ’el- pîw
verses.literal: The slacker buries his hand in the dish it wearies him to bring it back to his mouth

verses.original: עָצֵ֣ל חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָ֑יו מִ֝שִּׁבְעָ֗ה מְשִׁ֣יבֵי טָֽעַם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ṣêl ḥā·ḵām bə·‘ê·nāw miš·šiḇ·‘āh mə·šî·ḇê ṭā·‘am
verses.literal: The slacker [is] wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer discreetly

verses.original: מַחֲזִ֥יק כָ֑לֶב בְּאָזְנֵי־ עֹבֵ֥ר מִ֝תְעַבֵּ֗ר עַל־ רִ֥יב לֹּֽא־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ma·ḥă·zîq ḵā·leḇ bə·’ā·zə·nê- ‘ō·ḇêr miṯ·‘ab·bêr ‘al- rîḇ lō- lōw
verses.literal: Like one who grabs a dog by the ears is a passerby who meddles in a quarrel not his own

verses.original: כְּֽ֭מִתְלַהְלֵהַּ הַיֹּרֶ֥ה זִקִּ֗ים וָמָֽוֶת׃ חִצִּ֥ים
verses.transliteration: kə·miṯ·lah·lê·ah hay·yō·reh ziq·qîm wā·mā·weṯ ḥiṣ·ṣîm
verses.literal: Like a madman shooting firebrands and deadly arrows

verses.original: כֵּֽן־ אִ֭ישׁ רִמָּ֣ה אֶת־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אָמַ֗ר אָֽנִי׃ הֲ‍ֽלֹא־ מְשַׂחֵ֥ק
verses.transliteration: kên- ’îš rim·māh ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū wə·’ā·mar ’ā·nî hălō- mə·śa·ḥêq
verses.literal: so is the man who deceives - his neighbor and says I was only joking

verses.original: בְּאֶ֣פֶס עֵ֭צִים אֵ֑שׁ תִּכְבֶּה־ וּבְאֵ֥ין נִ֝רְגָּ֗ן מָדֽוֹן׃ יִשְׁתֹּ֥ק
verses.transliteration: bə·’e·p̄es ‘ê·ṣîm ’êš tiḵ·beh- ū·ḇə·’ên nir·gān mā·ḏō·wn yiš·tōq
verses.literal: Without wood a fire goes out without gossip a conflict ceases

verses.original: פֶּחָ֣ם לְ֭גֶחָלִים וְעֵצִ֣ים לְאֵ֑שׁ מְדוֹנִים וְאִ֥ישׁ לְחַרְחַר־ רִֽיב׃פ
verses.transliteration: pe·ḥām lə·ḡe·ḥā·lîm wə·‘ê·ṣîm lə·’êš mə·ḏō·nīm wə·’îš lə·ḥar·ḥar- rîḇ
verses.literal: Like charcoal for embers and wood for fire so is a quarrelsome man for kindling strife

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי־ בָֽטֶן׃
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê nir·gān kə·miṯ·la·hă·mîm wə·hêm yā·rə·ḏū ḥaḏ·rê- ḇā·ṭen
verses.literal: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels that go down into the inmost being . . .

verses.original: כֶּ֣סֶף סִ֭יגִים מְצֻפֶּ֣ה עַל־ חָ֑רֶשׂ דֹּלְקִ֣ים שְׂפָתַ֖יִם רָֽע׃ וְלֶב־
verses.transliteration: ke·sep̄ sî·ḡîm mə·ṣup·peh ‘al- ḥā·reś dō·lə·qîm śə·p̄ā·ṯa·yim rā‘ wə·leḇ-
verses.literal: Like glaze . . . covering . . . an earthen vessel are burning lips and a wicked heart

verses.original: שׂוֹנֵ֑א יִנָּכֵ֣ר בִּשְׂפָתוֹ יָשִׁ֥ית מִרְמָֽה׃ וּ֝בְקִרְבּ֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: śō·w·nê yin·nā·ḵêr biś·p̄å̄·ṯō yā·šîṯ mir·māh ū·ḇə·qir·bōw
verses.literal: A hateful man disguises himself with his speech but he lays up deceit in his heart

verses.original: כִּֽי־ ק֭וֹלוֹ יְחַנֵּ֣ן אַל־ תַּֽאֲמֶן־ בּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י שֶׁ֖בַע תּוֹעֵב֣וֹת בְּלִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- qō·w·lōw yə·ḥan·nên ’al- ta·’ă·men- bōw kî še·ḇa‘ tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ bə·lib·bōw
verses.literal: When he speaks graciously do not believe him for seven abominations [fill] his heart

verses.original: שִׂ֭נְאָה תִּכַּסֶּ֣ה בְּמַשָּׁא֑וֹן רָעָת֣וֹ תִּגָּלֶ֖ה בְקָהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: śin·ʾāh tik·kas·seh bə·maš·šā·’ō·wn rā·‘ā·ṯōw tig·gā·leh ḇə·qā·hāl
verses.literal: Though his hatred is concealed by deception his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly

verses.original: כֹּֽרֶה־ שַּׁ֭חַת יִפֹּ֑ל בָּ֣הּ וְגֹ֥לֵ֥ל אֶ֝בֶן תָּשֽׁוּב׃ אֵלָ֥יו
verses.transliteration: kō·re·hō·ša- ša·ḥat̲ yip·pōl bāh wə·ḡō·lêl ’e·ḇen tā·šūḇ ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: He who digs a pit will fall into it and he who rolls a stone will have it roll back on him

verses.original: שֶׁ֭קֶר לְֽשׁוֹן־ יִשְׂנָ֣א דַכָּ֑יו חָ֝לָ֗ק וּפֶ֥ה יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה מִדְחֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: še·qer lə·šō·w·nō·še- yiś·nā ḏak·kāw ḥā·lāq ū·p̄eh ya·‘ă·śeh miḏ·ḥeh
verses.literal: A lying tongue hates those it crushes and a flattering mouth causes ruin
